#work-heading(
    "Building Services Engineering Intern",

#custom-title("Projects")[
  #project-heading(

  )[
    - Conducted comprehensive feasibility analysis and transportation planning study for intercontinental passenger and freight rail infrastructure development, performing stakeholder analysis, risk assessment, and market opportunity evaluation
    - Applied quantitative analysis methodologies including financial modeling, Monte Carlo simulations, NPV/IRR calculations, and sensitivity analysis to evaluate project viability and ROI projections
    - Synthesized geospatial data, demographic analytics, socioeconomic indicators, and transportation demand forecasting models to develop data-driven recommendations for sustainable infrastructure investment
    - Delivered executive summary report with strategic recommendations incorporating cost-benefit analysis (CBA), risk mitigation strategies, and multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) frameworks
  ]
  #project-heading(
    "IoT Weather Monitoring & Data Acquisition System | Full-Stack Development",
  )[
    - Engineered end-to-end IoT solution utilizing Arduino microcontroller, temperature/humidity sensors (DHT22), and embedded systems programming for real-time environmental data collection and transmission
    - Developed cloud-based time-series database infrastructure using Docker containerization, implementing data ingestion pipelines, RESTful API endpoints, and automated data archival processes for historical trend analysis
    - Built responsive web-based dashboard with real-time data visualization, implementing WebSocket protocol for live updates, and integrated alerting mechanisms for anomaly detection
    - Deployed self-hosted solution on Linux server with network configuration, SSL/TLS encryption, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and implemented backup/disaster recovery procedures
  ]
]
